propositions: Buffered two-write append to info/exclude can interleave at byte level under concurrent first use and corrupt pattern lines; replacing with single atomic os.write to O_APPEND descriptor prevents tearing on POSIX

Exclusion-write and git status failures during push.py locked phase lack direct test coverage for strict mode (typed PushDeliveryError with stage-failed reason) and default mode (logged warning, content retained, clean retry succeeds)
Lock artifacts (.ticket-write.lock and .ticket-write.lock.d/*) must not appear in the committed git tree; legacy-tracker real-commit test via git ls-tree -r proves exclusion is effective and enforced
Concurrent first-use of exclusion update must preserve line integrity and presence across all patterns when multiple workers race during initial exclude file installation
